transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Lately I keep hearing this voice telling me my heart is going to give out and that it’s already too late for me. It sounds so real, and it has me feeling completely lost.
How long have you been hearing this voice, and have you been experiencing these thoughts for less than a month or for a longer period?
I've been hearing that voice and feeling this heavy sadness for about four months now. It started up a few weeks after the cardiologist first told me about my heart disease.
During these past four months, have you experienced periods of feeling unusually energized, irritable, or unable to sleep, or has the sadness been the primary mood throughout this time?

No, I haven't had any times where I felt energized or high at all. It has just been this heavy, empty sadness the entire four months. If anything, I've felt the exact opposite—just bone-tired, heavy, and completely slowed down.
When you hear this voice telling you that your heart is failing, does it feel like a reflection of your intense sadness and hopelessness, or does the voice speak about things unrelated to your mood?

Yes, it definitely feels tied to how hopeless and empty I am. I never heard that voice or thought my heart was doomed before I sank into this deep depression. It only started after I lost all hope and felt like I couldn't even get out of bed.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of severe depression, sadness, or hearing voices like this at any point in your life before these last four months?

No, I've never gone through anything like this before in my life. This is the very first time I've ever felt this kind of deep sadness or heard that voice. Before all of this started, I was always able to just keep going.
